categories.text: Animated words and letters: typewriter, scramble, highlight, glitch, kinetic type.
categories.entrances: How a thing appears or leaves: fade, slide, scale, blur, spring, stagger.
categories.transitions: Cuts between two shots: wipes, pushes, zooms, light leaks.
categories.backgrounds: Full-frame backdrops: gradients, grids, particles, noise, light.
categories.data: Numbers made visible: charts, counters, progress, stats.
categories.interface: Rebuilt app parts: chat, cards, buttons, notifications, code, terminal, devices, browser, cursor.
categories.shapes: Lines and vector art: path draw, arrows, morphs, stamps, connectors.
categories.media: Pictures, video, sound and words on screen: frames, captions, audio visualizers, screen recordings.
categories.cinematic: Camera and lens: push, parallax, grain, vignette, letterbox, flashes.
categories.scenes: Whole layouts: title card, lower third, end card, templates.
categories.3d: 3D objects and scenes. WebGL items in the upstream catalog are not ported.
categories.icons: Symbols in the text colour, static or animated. Groups: Lucide categories.
categories.pictograms: Colour pictures of one thing (emoji style).
categories.animations: Lottie motion graphics: loading, success, confetti, hints.
categories.helpers: Code that other parts need; not a picture on its own.
